variants.headline: Still in view: home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Still in view: an expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.sub: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.
variants.body:
A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Still in view: distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.sub: The home world has sent a punitive expedition.
variants.body:
The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
